items.claim: Rafael Tobias is the first real light heavyweight that Lucas Fernando is going to be fighting against.
items.quote: Rafael Tobias is probably the first real light heavyweight that Fernando is going to be fighting against.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando carries a very good level of power and speed up to 205 pounds.
items.quote: what he's brought up to 205 pounds is a very good level of power and a good level of speed.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando has been getting his finishes primarily due to his speed.
items.quote: I think it's the speed more than anything that has been getting him these finishes.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando secured his recent fast finishes by investing in strikes to the body and legs.
items.quote: the fact that he's been investing in the body and the legs. That is how he's gotten back-to-back very fast finishes.

items.claim: Rafael Tobias lacks a real level of athleticism, does not move his head, and is stiff on the feet.
items.quote: This guy has no sort of real level of athleticism. He doesn't move his head. He's stiff on the feet.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando will be smaller than Rafael Tobias despite being taller.
items.quote: Lucas Fernando is going to be a lot smaller than him despite being taller

items.claim: Lucas Fernando will be much faster than Rafael Tobias.
items.quote: he's going to be so much faster.

items.claim: Rafael Tobias failed to pick up on what his opponent was trying to do and got trapped throughout the fight.
items.quote: he was not picking up what DR was trying to put down at all throughout the entire fight. And DR was setting him up, was trapping him.
